nodes.name: 📋 Read Config Sheet
nodes.notes: Reads the Config sheet. Two rows: guild_id and role_id. The bot token lives in n8n Credentials — not here.

nodes.name: ⚙️ Extract Config
nodes.notes: Collapses the Config sheet rows into a single item with guildId and roleId fields.

nodes.name: 👥 Get Pending Users
nodes.notes: Reads rows where status is blank. returnRowNumbers adds a row_number field so we know exactly which row to update. Zero results → workflow ends naturally.

nodes.name: 🔁 Loop (1 user at a time)
nodes.notes: Output 0 → current user item → HTTP Request. Output 1 → all users done → workflow ends.

nodes.name: 🌐 Call Discord API
nodes.notes: PUT /guilds/{guildId}/members/{userId}/roles/{roleId} using the n8n Discord Bot credential. neverError:true means 204, 404, 429, 403 etc. all come back as normal items with a statusCode field. continueOnFail covers network-level failures.

nodes.name: 📝 Process Response
nodes.notes: Translates the HTTP statusCode into done/not_in_server/rate_limited/failed and recovers user_id + row_number from the loop item via pairedItem chain. Output always has the four fields the Update node needs.

nodes.name: ⏱ Rate Limit Delay (250 ms)
nodes.notes: ~4 requests/second, safely under Discord's per-guild rate limit. Bump to 500ms if you see rate_limited rows appearing.

nodes.name: ✅ Update Row Status
nodes.notes: Updates the exact sheet row by row_number with status, timestamp, and error. Next run skips rows already marked.

parameters.content:
## 🚀 Discord Mass Role Assignment

### Flow (linear — no branches)
```
[Trigger]
  → Read Config Sheet
  → Extract Config
  → Get Pending Users
  → Loop (1 user at a time)
  → Call Discord API       ← uses n8n Discord Bot credential
  → Process Response       ← Code node; recovers user_id + row_number
  → Rate Limit Delay       ← 250 ms wait
  → Update Row Status      ← writes done/failed/etc to the sheet
  → (back to Loop)
```

### Google Sheets layout

**Tab: Config**
| setting  | value                |
|----------|----------------------|
| guild_id | 123456789012345678   |
| role_id  | 987654321098765432   |

✅ No bot token in the sheet — lives in n8n Credentials.

**Tab: Users**
| user_id            | status | timestamp | error |
|--------------------|--------|-----------|-------|
| 111222333444555666 |        |           |       |
| 222333444555666777 |        |           |       |

Leave status **blank** for pending rows. The workflow fills it in.

### Before first run
1. Replace `YOUR_SPREADSHEET_ID` on all three Google Sheets nodes
2. Connect your **Google Sheets OAuth2** credential on those nodes
3. Connect your **Discord Bot** credential on the HTTP Request node
4. Bot must have `MANAGE_ROLES` and sit **above** the target role in the hierarchy

### Status values
| Status          | Meaning                                      |
|-----------------|----------------------------------------------|
| `done`          | ✅ Role assigned                             |
| `not_in_server` | User left the server (404) — skipped next run |
| `rate_limited`  | Throttled by Discord — retried next run      |
| `failed`        | Other error — see error column               |

### Throughput
~4/sec · 10k users ≈ 42 min · 600k users ≈ 42 hrs across scheduled runs
